provenance.citation: This work uses data from SPHEREx, a joint project of NASA JPL and Caltech, obtained from the NASA/IPAC Infrared Science Archive (IRSA).
provenance.processing: IRSA IBE cutout -> reproject_interp (bilinear) onto north-up TAN grid; NaN = no coverage, non-finite IMAGE or VARIANCE<=0; FLAGS reprojected nearest-neighbour and NOT applied to pixels; lambda = WCS-WAVE at target (approximate, not calibrated CWAVE).

catalog_target.name: WISE 0855−0714
limitations: Position is observed Spitzer astrometry at MJD 56677.3, not a fitted barycentric reference position. Annual parallax at the anchor epoch is retained as an unknown offset (up to 0.454 arcsec).
Old proper motion uncertainties accumulate to roughly 1–2 arcsec by 2026.
Unknown radial velocity is explicitly assumed zero.
Known stationary blends in discovery field; no identification from a bright pixel.
Paper J2000 axes treated as ICRS at the stated position uncertainty; not a precision astrometric frame transformation.

spectrum.method: forced aperture photometry, radius 9.0 arcsec (pixel-centre inclusion), median background annulus +9..+27 arcsec, errors from VARIANCE; no aperture correction
caveats: Each frame samples ONE wavelength at this position (linear variable filter).
No aperture/PSF correction: fluxes are aperture-limited, not total.
Saturated (OVERFLOW) points are not reliable fluxes.
Template classification is not computed in cached snapshots.

checks.label: OVERFLOW / saturation at position
checks.detail: 0% of 60 frames flag OVERFLOW in the central 3x3 px

checks.label: Gaia DR3 source at propagated position
checks.detail: No Gaia DR3 source (G<20) within 6 arcsec of the centre at mid-epoch

checks.label: Measured centroid shift vs predicted
checks.detail: Centroiding is computed by the live /v2/verdict service

checks.label: Photometric change between seasons
checks.detail: 16 wavelength-matched cross-season pairs; 4 differ >5 sigma and >20%; max 10.7 sigma at 0.822 um (D1); aperture follows the predicted track, so blending with field sources can mimic change

verdict.summary: Rule-based summary of the checks above computed by the snapshot generator; checks marked 'na' were not evaluated. Not a discovery claim.
